prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic raw smartphone torso portrait of an approved adult woman seated in a softly lit interior.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult brunette woman with straight shoulder-length hair and natural skin texture, seated frontally with relaxed shoulders. She wears a black rib-knit V-neck top, cream open-weave crochet cardigan, fish pendant on a black cord, and red star brooch with gold trim.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 vertical torso framing with teal-green wall panels, white molding, beige upholstered seating, black technical bag at lower right, and light wood table at bottom.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm 3000K indoor ambient light, gentle shadows through the cardigan weave and pendant, natural digital grain, calm modern mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone-style 35mm f/2.8 portrait, natural bokeh, realistic hair, skin, knit, lace, jewelry, wood, and upholstery texture.
